info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Workflow Transition Rules API
Atlassian Get Workflow Transition Rule Configurations

params.name: startAt
params.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: types
params.description: The types of the transition rules to return.

params.name: keys
params.description: The transition rule class keys, as defined in the Connect or the Forge app descriptor, of the transition rules to return.

params.name: workflowNames
params.description: The list of workflow names to filter by.

params.name: withTags
params.description: The list of `tags` to filter by.

params.name: draft
params.description: Whether draft or published workflows are returned. If not provided, both workflow types are returned.

params.name: expand
params.description: Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts `transition`, which, for each rule, returns information about the transition the rule is assigned to.

items.docs:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of workflows with transition rules. The workflows can be filtered to return only those containing workflow transition rules:

* of one or more transition rule types, such as [workflow post functions](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/modules/workflow-post-function/).
* matching one or more transition rule keys.

info.name: Atlassian Update Workflow Transition Rule Configurations

items.docs:

* [post functions](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/modules/workflow-post-function/)
* [conditions](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/modules/workflow-condition/)

info.name: Atlassian Delete Workflow Transition Rule Configurations

items.docs:
Deletes workflow transition rules from one or more workflows. These rule types are supported:

* [post functions](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/modules/workflow-post-function/)
* [conditions](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/modules/workflow-condition/)
* [validators](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/modules/workflow-validator/)

Only rules created by the calling Connect app can be deleted.
